column5: The student says yes. The parent pays.
column8: Joint-call script: ask who decides, bring the parent on, one plan for both

column5: "I'll think about it" usually means "I'm not sure yet."
column8: Ask course/timing/fee, prep the family conversation, book a time before hanging up

column5: If you're doing most of the talking, you're losing the call.
column8: 5 discovery questions; pitch only to the gap they name

column5: Working professionals don't want a certificate. They want a raise.
column8: Outcome pitch: where now, where next, the bridge, the proof

column5: Stop writing better ads. Start showing better proof.
column8: Proof ladder; collect at day 30 / results day; always written consent

column8: 4-part message: names, context, value, two-option question; 10 am–8 pm

column5: Last season's leads aren't dead. They're waiting.
column8: Sort by why they stopped, personal re-opener, 3-week sequence, then stop

column8: Call in 1 h → clip day 1 → parent call day 3 → honest deadline day 5 (already designed as the design-system sample; overlaps #2)

column5: You're tracking leads. Track these 4 numbers instead.
column8: Speed to first call, demo show-up, demo-to-admission, cost per admission (later 'for founders' series)

column8: Use only true deadlines (batch start, seat cap, early-bird end); say why it's real; never 'last 2 seats' unless true

column5: Your free masterclass is teaching. It should also be selling.
column8: Webinar flow: one useful strategy → live mini-test → the gap → offer → follow-up calls the same night

column5: Your happiest parents are your cheapest counsellors.
column8: When to ask (after a win moment), what to say, what to give, how to track referrals

column4: Lead magnets that bring serious leads
column5: Stop collecting leads with 'Download brochure'.
column8: Free mock test, rank/score predictor, PYQ pack, study planner, career-switch roadmap; follow up on the result

column8: Two qualifying questions (exam/year, who decides), score hot/warm/cold, fast-track the hot ones

column5: "My child can't focus in online classes." Here's how to answer.

column8: Map their week, 45-min plan, weekend option, recorded backup; show a learner with the same schedule

column5: The sale isn't done at "yes". Week 1 decides if they stay.
column8: Same-call payment link, EMI walk-through, welcome call, first-week check-in, first win by day 7

column4: Phrases to stop using on sales calls
column5: 5 phrases that make parents stop trusting you.
column8: Never promise a rank, no 'limited seats' lies, no 'everyone joins us', no rushing, no badmouthing others; say instead…

column5: Admissions follow exam season. Your marketing should too.
column8: Plan around board exams, results day, entrance results, new-year batches; what to post and run each month

column4: The first 30 seconds of the call
column5: You lose most sales calls in the first 30 seconds.
column8: Opening script: name + why you're calling + ask permission + one easy question; never open with the fee or a pitch

column5: When a parent names another institute, don't attack it.
column8: Compare on batch size, doubt support, test series, results of similar students; ask what they liked there; never badmouth

column4: Why demo bookings don't show up
column5: Your demo bookings aren't showing up. Here's why.
column8: Confirm on the same call, reminders 24 h and 1 h before, add the parent, give a small pre-demo task, call no-shows in 15 min

column4: "We'll join after board exams / next year"
column5: "We'll join next year" often costs a student a year.
column8: Count back from the exam date, show what the extra months buy, offer a foundation or bridge batch, book a check-in date

column5: A dropper has already failed once. Don't pitch like they haven't.
column8: Ask what went wrong last attempt, name the real gap, show a past dropper's result (with consent), a plan built for a second attempt

column4: "What if my child doesn't get selected?"
column5: "What if it doesn't work?" is a buying signal, not a no.
column8: Never promise a rank; say what you do guarantee (classes, tests, mentoring, tracking); share the refund policy in writing

column5: Your renewals are decided long before the renewal call.
column8: Monthly progress report, mid-year parent meeting with next-year plan, ask after a win moment, early-renewal benefit with a real deadline

column4: Your best training is yesterday's calls
column5: Your best sales training is already recorded.
column8: Review 3 calls per counsellor a week, 4-point scorecard (opening, discovery, objection, next step), role-play the moment that was missed

column5: Someone commented "fees?" Don't just reply "DM sent."
column8: Reply publicly with a question, DM within 10 min, ask exam/year before the fee, move to a call; save quick-reply templates

column5: Your counsellors are busy all day. Are they selling?
